notes.title: What’s next for Survivor TD: Favors of the Gods ?
notes.content:
ːsteamthumbsupː A sandbox-style demo… by design
The current demo was built as a sandbox-style experience, with minimal restrictions.

You could:

Progress very quickly,

Unlock powerful meta-upgrades,

Feel a glimpse of what endgame power might look like.

This made it fun to experiment and easy to get hooked - a lot of players played more than 30 minutes.
But it also came at the cost of challenge and strategy - especially for a game inspired by tower defense principles.
[hr][/hr]Where the game is going
Moving forward, the next update will focus more on tactical choices and strategic depth. Here's what's coming:

🔒 New limitations on towers availability > encouraging smart planning rather than brute force. 
🏹 Better control over enemy waves > so you can influence their path more meaningfully.
🛒 Reworked meta-progression > so long-term upgrades don’t overwhelm core skill expression.

The demo is updated frequently with new ideas.
[hr][/hr]Why it matters
Survivor TD isn't just about surviving - it's about crafting your own maze, controlling chaos, and building a powerful toolkit that feels earned.

Expect future versions to lean more into tower defense mechanics, while keeping the accessible fun that made the demo engaging.
[hr][/hr]
Thanks again for playing and wishlist-ing!
This project is still solo-dev powered, and your support makes a huge difference ːsteamthisː

ːsteamhappyː If you haven’t already, don’t forget to wishlist the game!

_ Cartable Studio

notes.title: Demo Update – Feedback Improvements!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thanks for all the feedback — I’ve made some key changes to the demo based on your suggestions:


Added glowing indicators for key buttons during the tutorial to improve UI readability and controls tooltips. 

Adjusted the early waves to allow a smoother progression and more time to discover game mechanics and powers.


Increased the drop rate of health packs from monsters.



Health packs are those tiny flames, if you were wondering [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656753/e9ccdfdbdf3e2ab829b12bc4781a339207f59115.png"]More updates are coming soon. Your feedback is super valuable, and I’m working hard to deliver the best version possible.



Thanks again for the support 🙏
